resources.string: After clearing, Mika works things out step by step again next time. Other settings aren’t affected.
%1$s · used once network access is on

Only for commands run here (http_proxy, https_proxy, all_proxy), and only while network access is on; Mika’s own model calls don’t use it. It may include a user name and password, which are stored encrypted on this phone. Leave empty for a direct connection.
Write it as http://host:port (https, socks5 and socks5h work too), optionally with user:password@ before the host.
A task is running in this chat; it can’t be cleared now
Files in the workspace of “%1$s” will be deleted: attachments you sent, screens you shared and files tasks wrote. The chat itself stays, but those files in it won’t open any more.
Files in every chat’s workspace will be deleted: attachments, shared screens and files tasks wrote. Chats stay. Chats with a running task are skipped.
The runtime and skills come with the app and aren’t cleared here; to start over, use “Reset environment” above.
Light or dark, whichever the phone is in
Let Mika change its own settings
When on, tasks get one tool to read and change these preferences (pace, mute, capsule, appearance, screen-on). Models, API keys, container network and anything that deletes data are never included
